_meta.description: Match scorer vectors computed by flightrisk.vision.scorer.MatchScorer. Weights reid 0.35, face 0.40, reasoning 0.25 and match threshold 0.45. The Python scorer rounds with round(x, 3) (round half to even on the exact binary value); the Kotlin and Swift scorers must produce exactly these combined scores.
_meta.encoding: NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are written as the strings "NaN", "Infinity" and "-Infinity" because JSON has no such numbers.
_meta.regenerate: Run the generator described in tests/test_match_score_vectors.py (the test recomputes every vector from the Python scorer and fails on any difference).
